Team —

Quick kickoff for today: leadership asked for a condensed, account-level package we can use in the Friday QBR. I kicked off an "on-call" style forecast drill to tighten numbers and surface any carry risks. Please do two things by EOD: 

1) Open the attached ben_qbr_oncall_prep_v1.xlsx and populate the "Account Notes" tab for any accounts you own (high-level bullets: milestone, last engagement, procurement blockers, committed next step, likelihood).
2) For deals > $250k, add a single-line justification for any movement >10% vs current forecast and flag whether legal/procurement is required.

I've started a short list of priority accounts (Acme, Veridian, Starlight). I expect Marissa to adjust a few numbers after her customer calls. Evelyn — please call out anything you want escalated to the exec readout.

Attachments: ben_qbr_oncall_prep_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks —
Ben

ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Ben — quick notes from my side as I triage: 

- Prioritization: focus 1) Acme (close + procurement), 2) Veridian (technical POC risk), 3) Starlight (pricing negotiation). Everything else gets a single-line CLR (confidence level reason).
- OKR tie: remind account owners to call out any feature asks that map to our "Throughput & Cost" OKR — we need to show at least three customer asks that validate the priority.
- Exec asks: if an account requests SLA exceptions or dedicated capacity, mark it as "exec escalation" and cc me.

I'll add a short "escalation rationale" column to Ben's workbook and push my version by 12:00.
